title.zh: 把模板里的占位符填上

intro.zh: render 把 '{name}' 换成值里的 name。现在只认一层名字，找不到就写成 undefined，也没法写出真正的大括号。
intro.en: render turns '{name}' into the name from the values. Today it only knows one level of name, writes undefined when it finds nothing, and has no way to write a real brace.

zh: 占位符里可以用点走进去：{user.name} 取 values.user.name。
值不存在时，占位符原样留在结果里。
{{ 和 }} 表示一个真正的 { 和 }。
0 和 false 也是值，要写出来；只有 undefined 和 null 算不存在。
en: A placeholder may use dots to walk in: {user.name} takes values.user.name.
When the value is not there, the placeholder stays in the result exactly as written.
0 and false are values and get written out; only undefined and null count as missing.

hint.zh: 一次正则同时认三种东西：{{、}}、和 {…}。占位符里按点拆开，一层层往下取。
hint.en: One regular expression for all three things: {{, }}, and {…}. Inside a placeholder, split on the dots and walk down a level at a time.

hiddenTests.title: card 10: a dotted path walks into the values
card 10: a value that is not there stays as written
card 10: doubled braces are literal braces
